title: Registration & Payment — official English registration page (forms, deposit, medical certificate)
publisher: Tenzing Hillary Everest Marathon (event organiser, Kathmandu)
claims: The mandatory Registration, KYC, Medical and Credit Card forms must be prepared and sent before 30 April 2027 to reserve a place, emailed to info.guys@EverestMarathon.com.
Signing up only saves a spot; an amount of USD 500 is required to confirm the place, and this amount is non-refundable.
The Medical Form requires a medical certificate from the runner's doctor stating that the runner is healthy, free of injury, and comfortable at high altitudes.
Payment can be made by Visa or MasterCard, bank draft, or bank wire transfer.
Event Director is Mr. Shikhar Pandey, based in Kathmandu (+977 985 111 333), Shikhar@EverestMarathon.com; country coordinators are listed on the page.
